destination.name: Xikou
destination.tagline: A mountain town in Fenghua known as Chiang Kai-shek's hometown, below Xuedou Mountain
destination.description: Xikou is a small town south-west of Ningbo, best known as the hometown of Chiang Kai-shek. His family home and the salt shop where he was born are open to visitors. Above the town rises Xuedou Mountain, a Buddhist hill with Xuedou Temple, associated with the monk Budai, and the Qianzhangyan cliff. The town and mountain pair easily as a day out of Ningbo.

goodToKnow.title: Day trip from Ningbo
goodToKnow.detail: Xikou is about 33 km from central Ningbo, so go early and plan to combine the town with Xuedou Mountain in one day.

goodToKnow.title: Wear walking shoes
goodToKnow.detail: Xuedou Mountain involves steps and slopes between the temple and cliff. Rain makes stone paths slippery.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Xikou is best in {months}, when walking on Xuedou Mountain is pleasant and the weather is clear.
